---
title: "Day 3 Revision: Mortality Parameterization (CFR) & Imported Cases"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk[["set"]](echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(deSolve)
library(ggplot2)
```

## 1. Competing Death and Recovery Rates (`SIR_model`)
Here, recovery (`tau = 1/10`) and disease-induced death (`delta = 1/10`) act as competing hazards. Notice that `P` (living population) excludes `D`.

```{r competing-rates}
SIR_model <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    # Living population size (excludes dead compartment D)
    P <- (S + I + R)
    lam <- parameters['beta'] * I / P
    
    dS <- mu * P - mu * S - lam * S         
    dI <- lam * S - tau * I - delta * I - mu * I 
    dR <- tau * I - mu * R
    dD <- delta * I
    
    list(c(dS, dI, dR, dD))
  }) 
}

# Initial conditions (P = 999, 1 initial infected, 0 dead)
initP <- 999 
initI <- 1 
initR <- 0 
initD <- 0
initS <- initP - initI - initR
istate <- c(S = initS, I = initI, R = initR, D = initD)

# Parameters: equal recovery and death rates (both 1/10)
parameters <- c(
  mu = (1 / (50 * 52 * 7)),    
  beta = 0.25,              
  tau = 1 / 10,
  delta = 1 / 10
)

time_start <- 0
time_stop <- 600
deltat <- 0.1
tps <- seq(time_start, time_stop, by = deltat)

out <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SIR_model, parms = parameters) 
Result <- as.data.frame(out)

# Phase plane (S vs I), all compartments, and cumulative deaths (D)
plot(Result[["S"]], Result[["I"]], type = "l", xlab = "S", ylab = "I")
plot(out)
plot(Result[["time"]], Result[["D"]], type = "l", ylim = c(0, 400), 
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Cumulative Deaths (D)")
```

## 2. Mutually Exclusive Death and Recovery Rates (`SIR_model2`)
To explicitly control the Case Fatality Ratio (`phi = 0.1`), we weight recovery by `(1 - phi)` and death by `phi`.

```{r mutually-exclusive}
SIR_model2 <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    P <- (S + I + R)
    lam <- parameters['beta'] * I / P
    
    dS <- mu * P - mu * S - lam * S         
    dI <- lam * S - (1 - phi) * tau * I - delta * phi * I - mu * I 
    dR <- (1 - phi) * tau * I - mu * R
    dD <- delta * phi * I
    
    list(c(dS, dI, dR, dD))
  }) 
}

parameters2 <- c(
  mu = (1 / (50 * 52 * 7)),    
  beta = 0.25,              
  tau = 1 / 10,
  delta = 1 / 10,
  phi = 1 / 10   # Target Case Fatality Ratio = 10%
)

R0 <- parameters2['beta'] / (parameters2['tau'] + parameters2['mu'])
R0

out2 <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SIR_model2, parms = parameters2) 
Result2 <- as.data.frame(out2)

plot(out2)
plot(Result2[["S"]], Result2[["I"]], type = "l", xlab = "S", ylab = "I")

# Compare cumulative deaths: Model 1 (black, ~50% CFR) vs Model 2 (red, 10% CFR)
plot(Result[["time"]], Result[["D"]], type = "l", ylim = c(0, 400), 
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Cumulative Deaths (D)")
lines(Result2[["time"]], Result2[["D"]], col = "red", lwd = 2)

# Check realized Case Fatality Ratio: D / (D + R) at the end of the outbreak
# Model 1 gives ~0.50 (50%), whereas Model 2 gives ~0.10 (matches phi = 0.1!)
tail(Result[["D"]], 1) / (tail(Result[["D"]], 1) + tail(Result[["R"]], 1))
tail(Result2[["D"]], 1) / (tail(Result2[["D"]], 1) + tail(Result2[["R"]], 1))
```

## 3. Imported Infections & Sub-Threshold Persistence (`R0 < 1`)
Adding `imp` external infectious cases to the force of infection (`beta * (I + imp) / P`) allows transmission to persist even when local `beta = 0.09` (`R0 < 1`).

```{r imported-cases}
SIR_model2_import <- function(t, state, parameters) {
  with(as.list(c(state, parameters)), {
    P <- (S + I + R)
    lam <- parameters['beta'] * (I + imp) / P
    
    dS <- mu * P - mu * S - lam * S         
    dI <- lam * S - (1 - phi) * tau * I - delta * phi * I - mu * I 
    dR <- (1 - phi) * tau * I - mu * R
    dD <- delta * phi * I
    
    list(c(dS, dI, dR, dD))
  }) 
}

# Compare phase plane with 0 imports (black) vs 10 constant imports (magenta)
parameters2['imp'] <- 10
out2_import <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SIR_model2_import, parms = parameters2) 
Result2_import <- as.data.frame(out2_import)

plot(Result2[["S"]], Result2[["I"]], type = "l", ylim = c(0, 300), xlab = "S", ylab = "I")
lines(Result2_import[["S"]], Result2_import[["I"]], col = "magenta", lwd = 2)

# Lower beta to 0.09 (so R0 < 1) and loop over importation rates from 0 to 10
parameters2['beta'] <- 0.09
import_vector <- seq(0, 10, by = 1)
result_import <- data.frame(time = numeric(0), I = numeric(0), imp = numeric(0))

for (i in 1:length(import_vector)) {
  parameters2["imp"] <- import_vector[i]
  out_aux <- deSolve::ode(y = istate, times = tps, func = SIR_model2_import, parms = parameters2) 
  aux_mat <- data.frame(time = out_aux[, 1], I = out_aux[, 3], imp = import_vector[i])
  result_import <- rbind(result_import, aux_mat)
}

# Plot local prevalence I(t) across importation levels when R0 < 1
ggplot(result_import) +
  geom_line(aes(x = time, y = I, colour = as.factor(imp))) +
  labs(title = "Sub-Threshold Persistence (R0 < 1) Driven by Imported Cases",
       x = "Time (days)", y = "Local Infectious (I)", colour = "Imported Cases (imp)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
